title: Section 1, the hero: what moves behind the line
question: What moves behind the line, so a visitor knows in a second that this is about their clothes?
purpose: Ben picked the line alone (board 1) and asked for something ambient that reads as clothing, dark by default, with the hands and the wordmark face marking words.

variants.label: A. The rail: real listings drift past
B. The stitches: garment seams drift
C. The walls: listings climb either side
